ood_applicability_thresholds.saturation_tier_route: match empirical saturation proxy to low/moderate/high/extreme tier model

reproducibility_notes: Package is built from retained Cycle 39 artifacts after raw/intermediate 100K files were pruned.
No new simulation, alignment, or neural training is performed by packaging.
Empirical inference requires QC, OOD gates, simulation-matched calibration, and external benchmarks.

validation_decision.reason: The 100K simulation-supervised validation passes on retained summaries, model artifacts, truth audits, method policies, and stage markers; raw/intermediate directories were pruned after completion and cannot be directly revalidated.
